correctness.rationale: For any cyclic ordering of the n=4k−2 remaining nonzero distinct binary columns, each edge has exactly k−1 nonzero functionals zero on both independent endpoints. Thus sum_{a≠0}e_a=n(k−1), forcing max e_a>=k−1 and pair minimum <=3k−1. A primitive-field Singer cycle minus 1 has edge differences all distinct except deleted t,s and duplicated c=t+s. Reversing the suffix at the disjoint existing difference-c edge replaces two c edges by two difference-1 edges, forming a single Hamiltonian cycle. The new difference multiset yields 4e_a=n−3−chi_a(t)−chi_a(s)−chi_a(c), hence e=k−2 for k−1 characters and k−1 for 3k characters, proving sharp enumerator. Three-vector independence ensures naive deletion min 3k−2. Independently built the GF(8) cycle and enumerated all 720 orders, finding exactly 96 orders with optimum distance five and the predicted histogram.
